notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Asmodeus' first ability by paying {B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw seven cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the permanent tapped in step 1.
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Repeat until you have at least {B}{B}{B} available.
Repeat from step 2.
